learn.hook: Which is heavier: a kilo of cotton or a kilo of iron? Think before you answer!
points: We measure how heavy things are in grams (g) and kilograms (kg).
Light things like a biscuit packet or a pencil are weighed in grams. Heavy things like a sack of rice or a person are weighed in kilograms.
1 kg of anything weighs the same as 1 kg of anything else.

example.q: A watermelon balances three 1 kg weights and one 500 g weight. How heavy is it in grams?

learn.reallife: At the sabzi mandi, the shopkeeper puts weights of 1 kg, 500 g and 250 g on the balance.

quiz.q: How many grams make 1 kilogram?
quiz.explain: 1 kilogram is the same as 1000 grams.
quiz.mistake: Thinks 1 kg is 100 g, like 1 m is 100 cm

quiz.q: How many grams are there in 3 kg?
quiz.mistake: Multiplies by 100 instead of 1000

quiz.q: Which unit is best for weighing a packet of biscuits?
quiz.explain: A biscuit packet is light, so grams are best. Litres are for liquids and metres are for length.
quiz.mistake: Picks a unit that measures something else

quiz.q: Which is heavier: 1 kg of cotton or 1 kg of iron?
quiz.explain: Both weigh exactly 1 kg. The cotton just takes up much more space.
quiz.mistake: Thinks iron is always heavier because it feels hard

quiz.q: How many grams is 2 kg 500 g?
quiz.mistake: Writes 2 and 500 with a 0 in between

quiz.q: A bag of potatoes weighs 4000 g. How many kilograms is that?
quiz.mistake: Divides by 100 or 10 instead of 1000

quiz.q: Joseph puts weights of 500 g, 250 g and 250 g on a balance. What is the total weight?
quiz.mistake: Adds only two of the weights

quiz.q: A watermelon balances three 1 kg weights and one 500 g weight. How heavy is the watermelon?
quiz.mistake: Writes 3 and 5 together without thinking of place value

teach.ask: Gappu's bag says 1500 g and Kabir's says 1 kg 500 g. Whose bag is heavier?
teach.praise: Wow! 1 kg is 1000 g, so 1 kg 500 g is 1500 g. They weigh the same!
teach.nudge: How many grams are there in 1 kg? Try changing Kabir's weight to grams.

learn.hook: How many glasses of nimbu paani can you pour from one big jug? Let's find out!
points: Capacity is how much liquid a container can hold.
We measure capacity in millilitres (ml) and litres (l).
Small amounts like a spoon of medicine are in ml. Big amounts like a bucket of water are in litres.
2 l 250 ml means 2000 ml + 250 ml = 2250 ml.

example.q: A jug holds 1 l of nimbu paani. How many 250 ml glasses can it fill?

learn.reallife: Milk packets come in 500 ml and 1 l. Water bottles are often 1 l. Medicine is measured in ml with a small cup.

games.title: True or false?
items: That is the rule for capacity.
A bucket of water is best measured in millilitres.
A bucket holds a lot, so we use litres.
Two 500 ml bottles hold 1 litre in all.
A spoon of medicine is about 5 litres.
A spoon holds only about 5 ml.
2 l 500 ml is the same as 2500 ml.
A 250 ml glass holds more than a 1 l jug.
1 l = 1000 ml, which is more than 250 ml.

quiz.q: How many millilitres make 1 litre?
quiz.explain: 1 litre is the same as 1000 millilitres.
quiz.mistake: Thinks 1 l is 100 ml

quiz.q: Which unit is best to measure the water in a bucket?
quiz.explain: A bucket holds a lot of water, so litres are best.
quiz.mistake: Picks millilitres for a big amount

quiz.q: Which unit is best to measure one spoon of cough syrup?
quiz.explain: A spoon holds only a little liquid, so we use millilitres.
quiz.mistake: Picks litres for a tiny amount

quiz.q: How many millilitres is 2 l 250 ml?
quiz.mistake: Puts the digits in the wrong places

quiz.q: A jug holds 1 l of nimbu paani. How many 250 ml glasses can it fill?
quiz.mistake: Forgets that 1 l is 1000 ml

quiz.q: A tank has 3000 ml of water. How many litres is that?
quiz.mistake: Divides by 100 instead of 1000

quiz.q: Riya drinks 200 ml of milk every day. How much milk does she drink in 5 days?
quiz.mistake: Adds 200 + 5 or multiplies wrongly

quiz.q: A bottle holds 500 ml. Arjun has poured in 350 ml. How much more water is needed to fill it?
quiz.mistake: Adds the amounts instead of subtracting

teach.ask: Gappu has a 1 litre jug and some 250 ml cups. How many cups can Gappu fill?
teach.praise: Yes! 1 litre is 1000 ml, and 1000 ÷ 250 is 4 cups. Gappu is pouring now!
teach.nudge: How many millilitres are in 1 litre? How many 250s fit in it?

learn.hook: Mummy's shopping bag is getting heavy! Let's add, subtract and share weights and liquids.
points: To add or subtract, first write both amounts in the same unit, like grams or millilitres.
Add kg with kg and g with g. If the grams make 1000 or more, change 1000 g into 1 kg.
To compare, change both to the same unit first.

example.q: Mummy buys 2 kg 500 g of potatoes and 1 kg 750 g of onions. What is the total weight?

learn.reallife: Cooks measure flour and milk for recipes, and shopkeepers add weights to make a bill.

items.text: A 5 kg rice bag minus 1200 g leaves ___ g.
Each laddoo weighs 50 g. 1 kg has ___ laddoos.
1500 ml shared equally in 3 glasses gives ___ ml each.

quiz.q: Mummy buys 2 kg 500 g of potatoes and 1 kg 750 g of onions. What is the total weight?
quiz.mistake: Adds the grams but does not change 1000 g into 1 kg

quiz.q: A bag holds 5 kg of rice. 1200 g is used for a family function. How much rice is left?
quiz.mistake: Forgets to change kg into g before subtracting

quiz.q: A tank has 10 l of water. Kabir takes out 2 l in a bucket, 3 times. How much water is left?
quiz.explain: He takes out 3 × 2 = 6 l. 10 - 6 = 4 l are left.
quiz.mistake: Takes out the bucket only once

quiz.q: Kabir weighs 32 kg and Aisha weighs 28 kg. What is their total weight?
quiz.mistake: Finds the difference instead of the total

quiz.q: Each laddoo weighs 50 g. How many laddoos make 1 kg?
quiz.mistake: Uses 100 g for 1 kg

quiz.q: A jug has 1 l 500 ml of juice. It is poured equally into 3 glasses. How much juice is in each glass?
quiz.mistake: Forgets to change 1 l into 1000 ml

quiz.q: Which holds more: 2 bottles of 750 ml each, or 1 bottle of 1 l 250 ml?
quiz.mistake: Compares 750 with 1250 and forgets there are 2 bottles

quiz.q: Harpreet's school bag weighs 3 kg. She adds a 750 g lunch box. What does the bag weigh now, in grams?
quiz.mistake: Adds 3 + 750 without changing kg into g

teach.ask: Gappu added 2 kg and 300 g and got 302 g. What went wrong?
teach.praise: I see! First change 2 kg into 2000 g, then add 300 g. That makes 2300 g!
teach.nudge: Can Gappu add kilograms and grams directly? What should Gappu change first?
